documented provider/product/version-envelope capabilities and access possibilities
exact deployed provider/product/version/account/site identity, permissions, observed limits and field/object authority

forbidden_collapses: documented provider limit != observed occurrence limit
governed data cut != source system truth beyond the declared cut scope
compiler_laws: A vertical source need compiles first to provider-neutral source-system class requirements.
Provider/product selection may occur only after source-system class requirements are explicit.
A provider offer is eligible evidence for discovery but cannot satisfy an occurrence or connector execution gate.
A physical acquisition requires an exact occurrence, one eligible observed access surface and a connector whose exact versioned conformance receipts satisfy the requested class/interface laws.
Snapshot-to-change handoff, retries, schema drift, deletes, corrections, ordering, gaps and reconciliation are acquisition-plan semantics, not inferred from source or connector labels.
Downstream analytics consume only a sealed or explicitly partial governed data cut whose lineage names the occurrence, access surface, connector, plan and execution receipts.
Any missing identity or expired evidence yields a typed refusal or source-gap; the compiler does not guess.
